def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg,line=counts.most_common(2)[0][0],counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r1 in range(h-2):
        for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
            for c1 in range(w-2):
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    if any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r1+1,r2) for c in range(c1+1,c2)):
                        continue
                    if any(grid[r1][c]!=line or grid[r2][c]!=line for c in range(c1,c2+1)):
                        continue
                    if any(grid[r][c1]!=line or grid[r][c2]!=line for r in range(r1+1,r2)):
                        continue
                    for r in range(r1+1,r2):
                        for c in range(c1+1,c2): out[r][c]=4
    return out
